app.name: Bingo Math
app.mockHint: Running on a simulated server (mock) with 3 virtual players

home.title: Bingo Math
home.subtitle: Solve, mark, BINGO!
home.tip: A grown-up creates the room; kids tap Join room or scan the QR code.

create.title: Create room
create.needOperation: Turn on at least one operation
create.timerHint: When time runs out, another player is asked.
create.drawOnlyHint: Recommended with few players for faster games.
create.joinBaseInfo: Player address: {url} (can be changed after creating)

host.title: Room control
host.notHost: You are not the host of this room
host.notHostHint: Only the browser that created the room can control it. Please create a new room.
host.closedHint: This room is closed. You can create a new one.
host.lobbyHint: Let kids scan the QR code or enter the room code. Press Start when everyone is in.
host.modeRandomHint: Each question picks a random connected player.
host.modeFixedHint: One player always answers; Help asks someone else.
host.closeConfirm: Closing the room disconnects all players and cannot be undone. Are you sure?
host.readyHint: Press Next question when everyone is ready.
host.configLobbyHint: Saving settings in the lobby deals new cards to everyone.
host.configFinishedHint: New settings apply from the next round.

join.title: Address for players
join.localhostWarning: Phones will not be able to open this address
join.suggested: Tap to use a LAN address:
join.howToFindIp: Find this computer's IP: on Windows run ipconfig, on macOS run ipconfig getifaddr en0, then enter http://<IP>:<port> below.

screen.title: Main screen
screen.noTokenHint: Open the main screen with the button on the room control page.
screen.waitingStart: Waiting for the host to start…
screen.waitingNewRound: Waiting for the host to start a new round…

play.title: Join room
play.pickPicturesHint: Tap the 3 pictures shown on the screen, in order
play.kicked: You were removed from the room
play.kickedHint: The host removed you from the room.
play.roomNotFoundHint: Room not found or already closed. Please check the room code.
play.gameInProgressHint: Wait for this game to finish, then try again.
play.waitStart: Waiting for the host to start…
play.waitNewRound: Waiting for the host to start a new round…
play.replaced: You are playing in another tab or device
play.replacedHint: Your card and marked numbers are kept.

errors.invalid_phase: This can't be done right now

errors.too_many_rooms: Too many rooms, please try again later
errors.no_players: At least 1 player is needed to start
